gov_transport.ui.pt_fares_hint: Passengers buy a ticket before boarding. Price = distance (straight line between the stops) × fare per km, at least the minimum fare, + the IC supplement on IC trains.
gov_transport.ui.pt_costs_hint: Every trip pays its run fee (IC / RB) when it starts and the stop fee at every served stop, also the automatic trains.
gov_transport.ui.pt_nothing_booked: From nobody to nowhere: no running costs are booked.
